player_prompt.intro:
Ami Nim re Player {player_id} achi.
Ami lakchara achi, jate sabte pachim object ami nite parai.
Pratyek chal re, ekta pile bichar karo ar ek ya adhik object tate theke bad diyo.
'[pile quantity]' format babohar karo, jate pile pile index ar quantity hatat object sorai.
Udaharan, '[0 3]' pile 0 tate 3 object sorai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱣ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱥᱟᱹᱠᱷᱭᱟᱹᱛ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾ '[pile quantity]' ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨ ᱢᱮ.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Baidha kaj. Column {col} sima bahar re achi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: ᱯᱟᱭᱤᱞ ᱤᱱᱰᱮᱠᱥ ({pile_index}) ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱦᱨᱮ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱾
invalid_move.non_positive: ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱮᱱ ᱡᱤᱱᱤᱥ ᱠᱚᱢ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱵᱟᱹᱲᱛᱤ ᱵᱟᱧᱪᱟᱣᱜ ᱢᱟ᱾
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Pile {pile_index} tate {quantity} object sorate parbi na (matro {pile_count} baki achi).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} chal khelai [{pile_index} {quantity}], pile {pile_index} tate {quantity} object sorai.

outcome.win: ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰᱤᱭᱟᱹ {player_id} ᱫᱚ ᱯᱩᱪᱷᱤᱢ ᱡᱤᱱᱤᱥ ᱮ ᱦᱟᱛᱟᱣ ᱠᱮᱫᱼᱟ !
